name: Puuilo Oyj
summary: Puuilo Oyj functions as a prominent discount retail chain throughout Finland, offering a broad spectrum of products and services. Its extensive inventory covers categories such as construction materials, various tools, heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC) and electrical components, pet care items, automotive accessories, everyday groceries, household essentials, gardening supplies, and leisure goods. As of January 1st, 2022, the company's retail network comprised 34 brick-and-mortar stores across Finland, complemented by a fully operational online shopping portal. The business was founded in 1982 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Vantaa, Finland. Puuilo Oyj operates as a subsidiary entity of Puuilo Invest Holding AB.
